description: Player starfighter: a hull plus combinable weapon modules, each with fresh/worn/critical wear states. Every part is a full-canvas layer on one shared logical canvas, so layers stack without per-part offsets.
style_prompt: 16-bit arcade pixel art sprite, top-down orthographic view, crisp hard edges, flat colors, centered single object on a plain solid magenta background
style_negative: multiple objects, sprite sheet, grid, collage, text, logo, frame, border, perspective, side view, shadow, landscape, photo, blurry, gradient background

parts.prompt: small starfighter spaceship seen from directly above, nose pointing up, swept delta wings, twin rear engines, cockpit canopy, navy and teal armor plates, pale gold trim
three-pronged golden prism emitter weapon module, trident shaped crystal cannon pointing up, gold and ivory metal
single heavy plasma cannon barrel pointing up, thick armored orange glowing muzzle, mechanical weapon module
parts.negative: spaceship, wings, tank, hand, person, multiple guns
